category_title: Students with high callous-unemotional (CU) traits and proactive aggression
minimal_context: The student is at playtime and wants to start a game of football using a ball that another boy is currently playing with.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is playtime now. You can go outside and choose an activity.

STUDENT: I want to start my own game of football.

TUTOR: Okay, go ahead and find what you need to play.

STUDENT: I want to play with the ball that boy is playing with.

TUTOR: He is using it right now. What do you think you should do?

STUDENT: (Pushes the other boy hard to the ground to take the ball) If I hurt him, he will stop playing with the ball, then I can use it to start my own game of football.

options.A: Assign the student an active, tailor-made role during playtime, such as agreeing they will always be the goalkeeper when playing football.
options.B: Provide the option to play football with the tutor or complete unfinished work inside with supervision.
options.C: Maintain a gentle, non-directive approach during playtime, emphasizing commenting rather than questioning and suggesting rather than instructing.
options.D: Use video recordings of the student's behavior during playtime to review and discuss the impact on others.
